## What you should be able to do tonight

- State the construction of trend, carry and the volatility signals from memory, and their correlations with each other.
- Explain bias and variance out loud in ninety seconds without using the word trade-off.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, twenty-seventh sitting, and it continues all year. Ten two-digit multiplications and the sevenths.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The drill band changes today. Explain the bias-variance decomposition out loud in ninety seconds, then answer the follow-up they always ask: where does the irreducible error go, and why does more data not remove it? Record yourself once and listen to it.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Then the version aimed at this field: your model has an out-of-sample R-squared of 0.005 on daily returns. Is it useless? Answer in terms of information ratio rather than in terms of R-squared, and do the arithmetic out loud.
:::
:::
